name: Darkrider extends the duration of Mark spells by 50% (#2466)
contract: Darkrider 704980 reads 'Increases the duration of your Mark spells by 50% and increases your spell penetration by 75, scaling with level' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). Mark(SpellInfo const*) (promoted from AscensionXorothAuras.cpp to the shared AscensionXoroth.h/.cpp) identifies a family-23 spell by SpellFamilyFlags[1] bit 2147483648, which every Mark of Korth'azz/Blaumeux/Rivendare/Zeliek rank and its Greater form carries. Darkrider's own baked EFFECT_1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION, correctly classmasked to that same bit, BasePoints 49/DieSides 1 -> 50) relies on Aura::CalcMaxDuration's native modOwner->ApplySpellMod pass, but this module's own triggered Mark applications do not reliably reach that native path, so it is nulled in ApplyContracts; xoroth_casts::OnCalcMaxDuration (AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp) now multiplies the duration by 1 + Amount(704980, 1)/100 directly whenever the caster knows the talent and the aura being created is a Mark. Effect 2 (spell penetration) is out of this issue's reported scope and is untouched. At level 60 the owned Mark of Korth'azz rank is 707345 (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h).
